## Release v11.11 - [Feature Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v11-11-feature-release}

- **11.11.1, released 2026-09-24**
  - Mattermost v11.11.1 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Pre-packaged Zoom plugin version [v1.13.1](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-zoom/releases/tag/v1.13.1).
  - Pre-packaged Jira plugin version [v4.8.1](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-jira/releases/tag/v4.8.1).
  - Pre-packaged Playbooks plugin version [v2.11.2](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-playbooks/releases/tag/v2.11.2).
  - Added ``GlobalRelayMessageExportSettings.SenderAddress`` configuration setting to optionally set a fixed **From** address for Global Relay EML compliance exports.
  - Added a Plugin API method for session-scoped file action policy checks.
  - Updated OAuth application management and authorization endpoint handling.
  - Fixed an issue with user profile update handling.
  - Fixed an issue with output formatting in ``mmctl``.
  - Fixed an issue with bulk import handling for existing accounts.
  - Fixed the cloud preview introduction modal so it is vertically centered instead of sitting at the bottom of the page.
  - Mattermost v11.11.1 contains no database or functional changes.

## Release v11.10 - [Feature Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v11-10-feature-release}

- **11.10.2, released 2026-09-15**
  - Mattermost v11.10.2 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Pre-packaged Agents plugin version [v2.5.3](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/releases/tag/v2.5.3).
  - Updated how error details are formatted for session and OAuth authorization flows.
  - Updated AD/LDAP test connection handling to require re-entering the bind password when connection settings change.
  - Updated how user presence status responses are serialized.
  - Updated the msgpack fork to cap byte-string allocations.
  - Fixed an issue where a plugin request body wasn't properly validated.
  - Fixed an issue where team admins could accidentally update roles incorrectly.
  - Fixed an issue where OAuth requests did not check the server's outbound connection restrictions.
  - Editing an outgoing OAuth connection now requires re-entering the client secret before validating or saving.
  - Truncated PDF text extraction to a specific limit.
  - Removed the unneeded ``POST /api/v4/posts/ids/reactions`` endpoint.
  - Mention keywords are now limited to 500 keys and 50,000 bytes in total. Users or imports that exceed these limits receive a descriptive error.
  - Fixed the cloud preview introduction modal so it is vertically centered instead of sitting at the bottom of the page.
  - Mattermost v11.10.2 contains no database or functional changes.

## Release v11.7 - [Extended Support Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v11-7-extended-support-release}

<Attention>

**Breaking Changes**
 - Starting with v11.7.10, the updated `glibc-openssl-fips` bundle includes a new OpenSSL build that enforces the FIPS minimum key length of 112 bits for HMAC operations. The PostgreSQL driver (lib/pq) passes the database password as the HMAC key during SCRAM authentication, so a password shorter than 112 bits, or 14 ASCII characters, now causes a panic on connect rather than a graceful failure. Before upgrading, FIPS deployments should verify that the password in `SqlSettings.DataSource` is at least 14 characters and rotate it in PostgreSQL if it is shorter. Standard, non-FIPS builds are unaffected.

</Attention>

- **11.7.12, released 2026-10-08**
  - Mattermost v11.7.12 contains Low to Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Pre-packaged Playbooks plugin version [v2.9.6](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-playbooks/releases/tag/v2.9.6).
  - Pre-packaged Jira plugin version [v4.7.3](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-jira/releases/tag/v4.7.3).
  - Pre-packaged GitLab plugin version [v1.12.4](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-gitlab/releases/tag/v1.12.4).
  - Pre-packaged Zoom plugin version [v1.13.1](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-zoom/releases/tag/v1.13.1).
  - Updated custom emoji image processing to use the shared image decoder, so animated GIF sources are subject to the configured maximum image resolution and image decoder concurrency.
  - Updated file metadata preparation for post retrieval, channel bookmarks, and notification delivery.
  - Updated how file metadata is served for drafts and post edit history.
  - Updated OAuth application management and authorization endpoint handling.
  - Updated team filter handling in the users listing API.
  - Updated direct and group channel targeting for incoming webhooks while direct messages are scoped to team members.
  - Updated how channel mentions are handled in permalink previews.
  - Limited the input size accepted by the plain-text content extractor.
  - Added a Plugin API method for session-scoped file action policy checks.
  - Fixed an issue where extracting content from ZIP archives could lead to excessive memory consumption.
  - Fixed an issue where invalidating cached sessions did not propagate to already-open websocket connections in some cases.
  - Fixed an issue where relative date separators between posts did not update when the local day changed while a channel stayed open, leaving a stale "Today" separator and creating a second "Today" separator for posts made after midnight.
  - Fixed an issue with output formatting in ``mmctl``.
  - Fixed an issue with bulk import handling for existing accounts.
  - Fixed an issue where thread popout windows opened empty, showing only the thread header and message box.
  - Fixed an issue where clicking outside an image in a post but within the post area would open the image preview instead of interacting with the post.
  - Updated moment-timezone to 0.6.4 (IANA tzdata 2026d) so that scheduling, reminder and custom time calculations use the 2026 rules for British Columbia, Alberta, the Northwest Territories and Morocco.
  - Mattermost v11.7.12 contains no database or functional changes.
